When you have an espressivo you cannot let out,
you simply turn it into a melodia!

Her question made me wonder. Come to think of it,
why had she taken such an interest in me in the first place?

There walked a little girl holding hands with her mother. I could hear the light *tap, tap*
of her shoes. ...Even I was starting to grasp it, bit by bit.

Grazie! You felt my brillante, didn't you?
Did I help you find your smile again?
Now then, what about her? Oh, look, she's skipping, isn't she?

I begin to grasp the tempo. My grip on the maracas tightens.
Could performing alongside someone truly be this thrilling—

Passersby all stop in their tracks at the sound of Sounds of Earth's violin.
And it's no wonder. Her performance held that kind of power.

Do you see now? Every single person plays their own melodia.
It is a form of self-expression far richer than mere emotion!
Hehe. Well, you see—

Let me teach you the secret to truly feeling the melodia!
Follow me, amico!
...Huh?! I was so mesmerized, I completely lost track of time...!

...Hmm? They're out of sync with the violin.
Are they really her partner?

Con spirito! Ah, what an exhilarating melodia!
I'm starting to have a marvelous time myself!

That was totally amazing! Super awesome!
Play here again, okay? I'll definitely come watch!

......Hehe. A diminuendo armonia.
Is that truly the melodia you wish to play?

Sì! The overture is already ringing out!
It doesn't matter if it's clumsy. Follow your heart and ready yourself!

Look over there... You see that street performer dancing a marvelous danza?
Listen closely. What do you hear?

Did you hear it? He is in stretta.
What he plays is tension and passion. Quite grazioso, wouldn't you say?

Sounds of Earth's violin resonates throughout the area.
—In that instant, goosebumps broke out across my skin.

I turn my attention to the butcher calling out a cheerful "Welcome!"
He was greeting passersby with a warm, beaming smile.

It's quite simple, really. Yesterday, I happened to see you
playing such a doloroso melodia.

...Wait, whoa... Isn't she ridiculously good...?
Her tone is gorgeous! Insane...!

She guided my clumsy amateur playing and wove it into music.
Even I could tell her performance skills were nothing short of extraordinary.

Her dashing words draw cheers from all around.
Without thinking, I found myself bowing to the crowd as well—

You have experience with musica, don't you? There's no other explanation!
If you played that without any experience, you're an incredible diamond in the rough!
Hehe! Ahahaha!
Now, let us drop the needle.

I try closing my eyes and listening to the sounds. ...Shoes scraping across the pavement.
Rough, heavy breathing. Voices shouting, "Give it up for them!"

It was like a kind of magic. All I had to do was follow
her violin. Just doing that allowed me to naturally make music.
Now then, who's next? What about him calling out to customers over there?

...! Ahaha!
So that's how you felt my melodia!

To be honest, I wasn't entirely sure I understood completely.
Even so, there was one thing I knew for certain about Sounds of Earth.

Let me teach you the secret to truly feeling the melodia!
Follow me, amica!

Then, all of a sudden, the violin's tempo slows down.
Even an amateur like me could tell—she was adjusting to match my pace.

*shk-shk*, I shake the maracas reservedly. I tried my best
to play in a way that wouldn't distract anyone listening.

Grazie! You can look forward to it!
I promise you a session that will leave you truly animato!

Sì! There is a supreme armonia that the angeli play upon the turf—
the "Selection Race." I would love nothing more than for you to come!

I see, so she calls races "sessions" as well.
Having been uplifted by her music today, I had no reason to refuse.

Do not be afraid, agnellino. We shall start with an adagio.
Fear not, I will lead. I won't let you lose your way.

Her words remind me that I'm holding a maraca.
A duo? Does that mean...?

Ritenuto in moments of sorrow. Spiritoso in times of joy.
And tempestoso when emotions run too wild to contain.
You will surely understand tomorrow.

From there, she gradually quickens the tempo. As I shake
my maraca to match, it steadily turns into "real music"—

And when these sounds intertwine, what is born is—an ensemble!
The musica woven by this very shopping district!

Fufu, they may not do it consciously. Even so,
people naturally play their own melodia.

Ahaha. Didn't I say I would lead?
—Musica will never leave you alone.

I've never played an instrument on the street before... The crowd's
expectant gazes pierce right through me. There is clearly no escape.
Sì! Exactly so!

Come! Let us go together, musicista.
Have you forgotten? Today, we are a duo.

Grazie! Amore!
Did you savor our exquisite armonia?

I hope you fall asleep tonight holding this musica close to your heart.
If you do—I am sure we will meet again in your dreams.

...Fufu, it's only natural that you fall into tacet.
Yet I believe that you are not entirely deaf to my message.

I don't want to ruin Sounds of Earth's gorgeous performance.
I have to listen closely to her violin and match her!
Attacca! To a place where words cannot reach!

I can "hear" it, you see.
It is not difficult. You need only open your ears.

Ah, ever more amoroso...!
Say, won't you come watch tomorrow's session?

Braviiiiiisssssssimo!!!
What a magnificent session! My very soul trembled!
Now, feel the melodia, won't you? Follow your heart.

Before I know it, I am completely absorbed in the session.
I keep shaking the maraca on instinct. My heart leaps. The melody leaps too—

Oops, pardon me. It seems I've troubled
your lovely little ears. Fufu.

Guided by Sounds of Earth, I arrive at the shopping district.
Then, she leans in close to my ear.

The sound of applause snaps me back to reality. Looking around,
a crowd of a dozen or so onlookers is clapping for me and Sounds of Earth.
